subject: maths
question: The compound interest on {₹}8,000 for 1 year 6 months at 20\% p.a., compounded half-yearly, is:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹8,000

Rate of interest (R) = 20% p.a.

Time (T) = 1 year 6 months = 1.5 years

Compounding frequency = Half-yearly (n = 2)

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest (CI) = A - P

Amount (A) = P(1 + R/(n × 100))ⁿ × T
